bioParagraphs: I like working on projects that sit at that intersection: designing efficient algorithms, building computational models, or digging into data to find patterns that matter. What excites me most is taking a mathematical idea and shaping it into something that runs, scales, and holds up in the real world.

My research interests lie in the areas of High-Performance Computing, Distributed Systems, and Game Theory. I have a strong foundation in C++ and Python, and I enjoy exploring new technologies and frameworks to enhance my skills.

projects.title: Low Latency Trade Matching Engine
projects.description: Sub-microsecond order execution engine designed for high-frequency trading (HFT) environments. Built with modern C++26, utilizing std::hive for high-density memory layouts to maximize throughput under heavy market data load.

projects.title: Simulink-Based Android Security System
projects.description: Android-based physical security system built entirely in Simulink. In Node mode, a phone monitors ambient-light changes and gyroscope motion while armed, then reports breaches to a Monitor phone. The Monitor sounds an alert, displays the breach time and GPS location, and remotely controls the Node’s siren and arm/disarm state. A role slider lets the same app run on either phone.

projects.title: Realtime Carbon Credits Markets Analysis Platform
projects.description: Full-stack real-time analytics platform (Next.js, WebSocket, PostgreSQL) serving live carbon credit pricing, trend signals, and risk analysis. Built at Inter-IIT Tech Meet 14.0
